defects.description: Code token `consensus` was translated to `консенсус` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `conditional` was translated to `условно` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `no-consensus` was translated to `отсутствие-консенсуса` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `blocked-escalation` was translated to `блокирующая-эскалация` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `awaiting-operator` was translated to `ожидание-оператора` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `information-gap` was translated to `нехватка-информации` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `irresolvable-conflict` was translated to `неразрешимый-конфликт` instead of being kept unchanged.
Code token `risk-threshold-breach` was translated to `превышение-порога-риска` instead of being kept unchanged.
Identifier `phase_state` was altered to `Фаза_state`, breaking the exact token requirement.
